report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned 200 with 63-172ms durations; metrics show /v1/checkout 200 rate ~32/60s, zero 502s, and p95 ~247ms. Traces show successful end-to-end checkout spans with no errors. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert reflects healthy behavior, so no bounded root cause can be substantiated and the operator hypothesis is contradicted.
